title: Aangan Residence
subtitle: Living lounge · modular kitchen · dining · master bedroom

spots.title: Deep-seat sectional sofa
spots.text: A generous L-shaped sectional in mocha suede that seats the whole family — the heart of the lounge.

spots.title: Bio-ethanol fireplace
spots.text: A clean-burning, flue-free fireplace set into a floating white plinth below the TV.

spots.title: Stacked-stone TV wall
spots.text: Natural slate cladding frames the 75-inch TV, with every cable hidden inside the wall.

spots.title: Floating timber-slat ceiling
spots.text: A suspended grid of pine slats on steel beams marks out the seating zone and softens the acoustics.

spots.title: Paper lantern pendants
spots.text: A cluster of pleated paper pendants gives a soft, gallery-like glow over the sofa.

spots.title: Glulam timber arches
spots.text: Laminated timber arches on steel shoes span the room without a single column — the signature of this house.

spots.title: Tree-stump side tables
spots.text: Solid log side tables bring the outdoors in and double up as extra seats.

spots.title: Coffee bar console
spots.text: A slim charcoal console with log stools — for a quick coffee, a board game or laptop work.

spots.title: Tripod floor lamps
spots.text: Ash-wood tripod lamps add warm pools of light at eye level for the evenings.

spots.title: Games zone
spots.text: A full-size pool table under its own pendant turns one end of the lounge into a games room.

spots.title: Backlit stone walls
spots.text: Curved walls of pale stone are washed by hidden LED strips, so they glow like sculpture at night.

spots.title: Landscape art prints
spots.text: Large-format landscape photographs echo the timber and earth tones of the room.

spots.title: TV snug
spots.text: A second, quieter seating corner with its own TV — for kids’ movie nights.

spots.title: Wide-plank oak flooring
spots.text: Matte oak planks run seamlessly through the lounge for a warm, continuous base.

spots.title: Quartz waterfall island
spots.text: A 2.2 m island in white Calacatta-look quartz that flows down both sides to the floor — prep space, breakfast bar and storage in one.
specs: Deep drawers on the far side

spots.title: Handle-less base cabinets
spots.text: Deep navy lacquer drawers with a hidden finger-pull profile — clean lines and nothing to snag on.

spots.title: Walnut wall cabinets
spots.text: Walnut-veneer upper cabinets add warmth above the navy base units, with LED strips lighting the worktop below.

spots.title: Book-matched marble backsplash
spots.text: A single run of white marble-look slab from worktop to wall cabinets — no grout lines to clean.

spots.title: 4-burner hob & chimney
spots.text: A glass-top gas hob under a slim stainless-steel chimney with auto-clean and touch controls.

spots.title: Glass globe pendants
spots.text: Three clear glass globes with brass caps hang over the island at just the right height for prep and dinner.

spots.title: Brass bar stools
spots.text: Leather-seat bar stools on slim brass stems, with a footrest ring for comfort.

spots.title: Sink under the window
spots.text: An undermount steel sink with a matte-black pull-down tap, placed under the window for daylight while you wash up.

spots.title: Built-in oven & microwave
spots.text: Oven and microwave stacked at eye level in the tall unit — no bending down to check the food.

spots.title: Fridge column
spots.text: The refrigerator sits behind a full-height white gloss panel so the tall wall reads as one clean surface.

spots.title: Open walnut shelves
spots.text: Floating walnut shelves for glass jars and everyday cups — easy to reach and nice to look at.

spots.title: Coffee station
spots.text: A separate counter for the coffee machine and breakfast things keeps the main worktop free.

spots.title: Floor-to-ceiling pantry
spots.text: A tall white pantry with pull-out wire baskets swallows groceries, bulk staples and small appliances.

spots.title: False ceiling with LED cove
spots.text: A gypsum false ceiling hides the services, with a warm LED cove and recessed spotlights over the work zones.

spots.title: Large-format stone tiles
spots.text: 800 × 800 mm stone-look tiles with fine grout lines — easy to mop and hard-wearing in a busy kitchen.

spots.title: Six-seater breakfast table
spots.text: A solid oak table with upholstered chairs for quick family meals right next to the kitchen.

spots.title: Linear LED pendant
spots.text: A slim black linear light gives even, glare-free light over the whole table.

spots.title: Slim-frame sliding door
spots.text: Black-framed glass sliding doors bring in daylight and open onto the garden.

spots.title: Sage feature wall & art
spots.text: A soft sage-green wall and a two-tone canvas set a calm mood for the dining corner.

spots.title: Eight-seater dining table
spots.text: A solid dark-stained hardwood table with sculptural iron-framed chairs.

spots.title: Floor-to-ceiling glazing
spots.text: Full-height sliding glass doors open the dining room straight onto the valley view.

spots.title: Balcony with a lake view
spots.text: A slate-tiled balcony with a steel railing — morning tea with the whole lake in front of you.

spots.title: Curved timber-batten ceiling
spots.text: Dark-stained timber battens follow the curve of the roof and hide the services above.

spots.title: Built-in indoor grill
spots.text: A cast-iron built-in grill with a hidden chimney — barbecue nights whatever the weather.

spots.title: Stone serving ledge
spots.text: A tiled ledge beside the grill for serving dishes, lit by a warm wall sconce above.

spots.title: Open-plan family lounge
spots.text: Beyond the dining area the space flows into the family lounge and kitchen under one long ceiling.

spots.title: Linen drapes
spots.text: Floor-length linen drapes soften the glass and filter the evening sun.

spots.title: Large-format floor tiles
spots.text: Warm ivory tiles laid on the diagonal make the room feel even wider.

spots.title: Upholstered king bed
spots.text: A low platform bed dressed in crisp white linen with an olive throw that ties back to the accent chair.

spots.title: Wardrobes & mirror niche
spots.text: Floor-to-ceiling wardrobes frame the bed. The mirror-backed niche doubles the sense of depth.

spots.title: Wingback accent chair
spots.text: One bold chartreuse piece against a calm grey-and-white palette — the room’s single pop of colour.

spots.title: Layered curtains
spots.text: Sheer curtains for daytime privacy with heavy taupe drapes behind them for full blackout at night.

spots.title: Warm LED cove
spots.text: A hidden LED strip above the window washes the ceiling with a soft evening glow.

spots.title: Drop pendants
spots.text: Two slim black pendants hung at staggered heights light the reading corner without taking floor space.

spots.title: Curved work desk
spots.text: A black-oak desk with a curved return gives a proper workstation plus a tea and coffee corner.

spots.title: Diamond-pattern feature wall
spots.text: Subtle trellis wallpaper behind the wall-mounted TV adds texture without visual noise.

spots.title: Statement artwork
spots.text: A large-format canvas in greens and blues greets you at the entrance, lit by a wall washer above.

spots.title: Oak floor & hand-tufted rug
spots.text: Warm grey oak-look flooring with a black-and-ivory linework rug that marks out the sleeping zone.

spots.title: Frosted glass door
spots.text: Frosted toughened glass to the ensuite lets daylight through while keeping privacy.
